Test Case Description: Verify GRT Details screen loads successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in and has access to MicroFinance Data Entry modules
Test Steps: 1. Open Group Maintenance | 2. Navigate to Data Entry > GRT Details | 3. Wait for page load
Expected Result: GRT Details screen loads with all core sections and controls visible without blocking errors

Test Case Description: Verify hidden module ID value is rendered
Preconditions: Screen is opened with module context
Test Steps: 1. Inspect hidden field moduleId_grt_details
Expected Result: Hidden module field exists and contains module ID context value

Test Case Description: Verify window header controls are visible
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Observe header area
Expected Result: Title icon Refresh and Close buttons are visible and accessible

Test Case Description: Verify GRT Information section default expanded state
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Observe GRT Information section on first load
Expected Result: Section is expanded and form controls are visible

Test Case Description: Verify Behind the Scene section default expanded state
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Observe Behind the Scene section on first load
Expected Result: Section is expanded and audit items are visible

Test Case Description: Verify section collapse and expand behavior
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Collapse and expand each section using toggle buttons
Expected Result: Section visibility and chevron states change correctly

Test Case Description: Verify Scheme lookup opens search modal
Preconditions: Screen is in mode that allows lookup actions
Test Steps: 1. Click Scheme lookup icon
Expected Result: Search modal opens for Scheme lookup

Test Case Description: Verify Scheme selection populates Scheme ID and Scheme Name
Preconditions: Scheme lookup modal has result rows
Test Steps: 1. Search and select a valid scheme
Expected Result: Scheme ID and Scheme Name populate correctly

Test Case Description: Verify View action loads existing GRT record
Preconditions: Valid key context exists for a GRT record
Test Steps: 1. Click View | 2. Wait for load
Expected Result: Existing GRT details are loaded into all relevant fields

Test Case Description: Verify Add action enables data entry workflow
Preconditions: Screen is loaded in default mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Observe control and button states
Expected Result: Form enters add mode with editable fields and valid action-state transitions

Test Case Description: Verify Edit action requires an existing loaded record
Preconditions: No GRT record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit
Expected Result: System blocks edit and prompts to load/view a valid record first

Test Case Description: Verify Delete action requires an existing loaded record
Preconditions: No GRT record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click Delete
Expected Result: System blocks delete and shows validation message

Test Case Description: Verify required field validation on Save
Preconditions: Add mode is active
Test Steps: 1. Leave key required fields empty | 2. Click Save
Expected Result: System blocks save and shows required field validation for mandatory GRT inputs

Test Case Description: Create new GRT Details record with valid inputs
Preconditions: Add mode active and user has create rights
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid values across mandatory fields | 2. Click Save
Expected Result: Record is saved successfully and success feedback is shown

Test Case Description: Edit an existing GRT record and save
Preconditions: Existing GRT record is loaded in view mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit | 2. Change editable values | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Changes are persisted and reloaded values reflect updates

Test Case Description: Delete existing GRT record with confirmation
Preconditions: Existing GRT record loaded and delete permission granted
Test Steps: 1. Click Delete | 2. Confirm in prompt
Expected Result: Record is deleted successfully and screen resets safely

Test Case Description: Cancel in Add mode discards unsaved values
Preconditions: Add mode with entered but unsaved values
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Enter sample values | 3. Click Cancel
Expected Result: Unsaved values are discarded and form returns to stable default/view state

Test Case Description: Cancel in Edit mode restores original persisted values
Preconditions: Edit mode with unsaved modifications
Test Steps: 1. Load record | 2. Click Edit | 3. Modify fields | 4. Click Cancel
Expected Result: Original values are restored and edit mode exits

Test Case Description: Verify Loan Cycle No. accepts valid numeric input

Test Case Description: Verify Group Disbursement Time format validation

Test Case Description: Verify Installment Grace Period numeric validation

Test Case Description: Verify Previous and Next Reference navigation buttons
